result:
The harness generation is complete. Here's a summary of everything that was built:

## Harness Generation Summary

### Files Created

**`harness/src/tla_trace.rs`** — Per-thread trace emission module (Category B timebox)
- Thread-local NDJSON writers, zero mutex contention
- `Instant::now()` timestamps for `[start, end]` intervals
- Per-scenario re-initialization via generation counter
- 11 event emission functions matching the instrumentation spec

**`harness/src/preprocess_trace.py`** — Post-processing script
- Merges per-thread NDJSON files into single JSON with per-thread arrays
- Timestamp compression (raw nanos → dense integers)
- Reports cross-thread overlap statistics and event type coverage

**`harness/src/trace_tests.rs`** — 4 test scenarios
- `basic_send_recv` — Subscribe, Send, RecvSuccess, ReceiverDrop, SenderDrop, CloseChannel
- `concurrent_send_recv` — Multi-threaded with 3 threads, genuine concurrency
- `lagged_receiver` — RecvLagged path with capacity overflow
- `close_recv_race` — SenderClone, SenderDrop, RecvEmpty, RecvClosed, CloseChannel

**`harness/patches/instrumentation.patch`** — 328-line patch for broadcast.rs + mod.rs
- Adds `trace_id` and `trace_suppress` fields to `Receiver`
- Inserts trace emit calls at all 13 instrumentation points
- All existing 32 tokio broadcast tests still pass

**`harness/apply.sh`** / **`harness/run.sh`** — One-command reproduce scripts

### Traces Generated

| Trace | Events | Threads | Validation |
|-------|--------|---------|------------|
| basic_send_recv.json | 12 | 1 | PASS (15 states, 6 invariants) |
| close_recv_race.json | 10 | 1 | PASS (12 states, 6 invariants) |
| lagged_receiver.json | 14 | 1 | PASS (17 states, 6 invariants) |
| concurrent_send_recv.json | 27 | 3 | Needs `Receiver={"r1","r2","r3"}` |

### Event Type Coverage

10 of 11 instrumented event types appear in traces. Only `DeregisterWaiter` is missing (requires async recv cancellation, not exercisable via sync `try_recv`).

### Spec Adjustments Made

- **Trace.cfg**: Changed constants from model values to strings (`{"r1","r2"}` instead of `{r1, r2}`)
- **Trace.tla**: Added guard on `SilentCloseChannel` to not fire when next trace event is `CloseChannel`
